deploy-bot: [deploy] Starting staging deploy -> env=staging tag=release/v2.3.1-rc4 commit=9f1a2b3 pool=hydra-staging. Canary=10% for 10m, rollout plan: smoke tests -> canary -> gradual shift. Change window: 2025-11-12 02:00-04:00 UTC. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/staging-deploy
jen: ack, will kick off smoke tests now :rocket:
mike: starting smoke — quick heads up, reranker canary pods returning some 502s already
mike: log snippet: ```ERROR 502 upstream timeout /api/v1/reranker - workers/host-7```
sophia: seeing p95 latency jump on canary from ~120ms -> ~600ms, CPU and GPU mem trending up on the same hosts
ops-oncall: pausing traffic shift. @deploy-bot set hold on canary traffic, notify owners. :warning:
deploy-bot: Canary hold applied. Traffic freeze at 10%. Notifying assignees for investigation.
paulo: console shows model-worker OOMs on host-7 and host-9, suspect quantization kernel fallback. capturing container logs now
jen: can we pin to previous staging commit if we can't resolve quickly? previous commit is `8e7b6c2`
sophia: +1 on pin. smoke failing across reranker regression tests, want rollback to validate infra vs code change.
mike: creating a short issue with logs and stack traces, assigning eng-runtime, label=priority/urgent
ops-oncall: agreed. Recommend rollback to `8e7b6c2` and run perf/quant checks in a follow-up deploy.
deploy-bot: Initiating rollback on staging -> target_commit=8e7b6c2. Rolling back canary and workers, preserving logs/artifacts. ETA ~5-10m.
jen: thanks. I'll queue quick smoke after rollback.
paulo: copying logs to /artifacts/deploy-1939991234 for triage.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Staging now at commit=8e7b6c2. All canary pods replaced and healthchecks passing on control plane.
jen: running smoke suite now... all tests green :white_check_mark: (chatops smoke-suite run: pass)
ops-oncall: leaving note: require additional perf verification and smaller canary next attempt. tagging release owner for follow-up.
mike: filed runtime bug #RI-4289 for batch/kernel selection regression, assigned to @eng-runtime.
deploy-bot: Completed: staging deploy aborted and rolled back. Summary: start_ts=1939991234 start_commit=9f1a2b3 rollback_to=8e7b6c2 duration=18m actions=[canary_hold,rollback,smoke-verification]. Close reason: regression in reranker latency/502s.
